body: Fix: Staging api-server was missing EMAIL_PROVIDER/RESEND_API_KEY (only auth-server had them), so EmailService fell back to console and RFQ/PO emails never left the API. Applied EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend + RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM on staging api-server and added the same to terraform for staging/production. Please re-send an RFQ/PO after the next deploy and confirm inbox delivery.

Fix (near-term): Crunchwork Report API is not operational, so create remains stubbed. CTAs are now labelled "Report Creation Unavailable" and open the explanation dialog instead of a generic unexpected error. Full CW report create will follow when the Insurance REST Reports API is available for the tenant.

Fix: Journal photo upload drawer could trap users (preventClose during hung upload / missing journal context / MIME reject). Cancel/X now always works (force-close + abort), hung uploads time out, empty state is shown when no journal/folder, HEIC/extension MIME fallback added, and Documents drag overlay resets on Esc/dragend.

Fix: Estimate/PO line-item autosave was firing while a cell was focused (600ms debounce), then reload reset edit state mid-type. Autosave is suppressed while editing; after save we no longer clear the active edit cell.
Fix: Duplicate of the mid-type edit close bug. Autosave no longer closes the description field while you are typing (same change as the related estimate line-item edit item).

Fix: Scope reorder was only applied in the UI — the API path dropped scopes. Reorder now maps scopes into combos (scopes are combos in the DB) for estimates and purchase orders so order survives refresh.

Fix: Catalogue items could not drop onto an empty PO table (table target was invalid → browser 🚫). Empty-table drops are now allowed and remap to a group (server ensures a default group), so you can drag catalogue lines onto a new PO.

Fix: Issuing felt blocked without catalogue lines because empty POs could not receive catalogue drops, and Send still allowed blank PDFs. Catalogue drop onto empty PO works; Send PO is blocked with a clear toast when there are zero line items.

Fix: PO PDF mapper loaded all tenant combos/items then filtered, which could yield empty/misaligned groups. It now scopes combos/items by the PO’s group IDs (same pattern as RFQ). Please regenerate the PO PDF to pick up the fix.

Fix: PO Attachments tab was a stub and send wizards only attached the generated PDF. Attachments tab now uses the real entity attachments component; Issue PO / Send RFQ can attach job documents via the project documents picker.
Fix: Duplicate of the WO/vendor attachments report. Same change — real attachments tab + job document picker on send flows.

Fix: Accept/Decline only appeared for status Issued, while inbound CW maps Issued→Open. Accept/Decline now show for Received/Issued/Draft/Open; status updates resolve lookup by name; Help hints updated to real actions.
Fix: Creating a contact from a job-scoped Contacts list never linked it to the job, so it disappeared from the filtered list. Create now links the new contact to the current job via addJobContacts.

Fix: Message acknowledgement was gated by MESSAGE_ACKNOWLEDGE_ENABLED (off on api-server). Flag enabled in staging terraform and applied on the running service; UI now surfaces a clear error if acknowledge is still unavailable (501).

Fix: Help chat 400s from Gemini tool-loop thoughtSignature issues. Provider retries without tools on INVALID_ARGUMENT; error banner now offers Start new conversation and notes that History preserves the thread.

Fix: Create Job was shown without jobs.create permission (silent 403). Button is now gated on jobs.create. If Nellie should create jobs, grant jobs.create on her role in Admin → Roles (accounts/member roles do not include it by default).
Fix: Job detail Back hard-linked to /jobs and dropped ?page=. Back now prefers browser history / remembered list URL (page + filters). Same remember pattern applied on Claims list.

Fix: Create Make-Safe was hidden without explanation (not a Pending status gate). Button always shows; when unavailable it is disabled with a tooltip reason (no claim / no CW Builder Make Safe type / already Make-Safe).

Fix: Assessment Specialists only allowed a single specialistType. UI is now multi-select checkboxes writing specialistTypes[], with backward-compatible specialistType string retained for publish mapping.
Fix: Archive was an unlabeled trash icon and was hidden for insurer Closed statuses. Control now shows an Archive label and only hides when the claim is already archived.
Fix: Help felt like it lost conversations on close. Closing is blocked while streaming; a toast points to History; History icon has a tooltip. Threads remain in Help → History.
Fix: Duplicate of Help close / lost history. History drawer already existed; discoverability improved (tooltip + toast). Closing as resolved with the related Help UX changes.

Fix: Chat questions are not auto-written to Feedback (by design). Admin Feedback empty state and Help assistant copy now explain that Feedback items appear when you ask Help to log feedback; chat transcripts live under Help → History.
Fix: Help chat Enter now inserts a newline; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends (with hint text). Pop-out window not shipped in this pass — History + beside layout covers most of the follow-along need.
Fix: Clarified job overview labels — "First contacted (CW)" vs "Customer contact date" vs Booked date — so SMS/contact timing is not confused with the booked appointment date.
Fix: Job sidebar task count included completed/cancelled tasks. Count now excludes Completed and Cancelled.
Fix: PO Attachments tab was a placeholder. Replaced with real entity attachments and job-document attach on Issue PO (same work as the vendor attachments bug).
Fix: Journal header/metadata can now be edited (name, description, visit date) from Journal overview; page content editing was already available.
Answer: Use Communications → Notes for general job notes that are not site visits (journals expect a visit date). Closing this question with that guidance.
Answer (no code change): Crunchwork allows quote/report tools in parallel by design. Tool availability is intentional; estimators should follow the procedural workflow. Closing per prior reply.

Docs: Builder Assessment Workflow steps/tasks are largely IAG/Crunchwork-owned when CW triggers an assessment. EnsureOS guide should link that process and document EnsureOS-specific extras only — not invent a full CAPS end-to-end. Closing with that scope note; further guide edits can follow separately.

In progress: Schedule filter by estimator needs an API assigneeUserId (or equivalent) query param before the UI filter can ship. TODO left on ScheduleClient; next pass will add API + URL-persisted filter.
In progress: Prefer job Documents/Photos folder for non-visit photos (attachments path improved). Optional journal-without-visit-date remains a follow-up.
Deferred (larger feature): Out-of-hours Make Safe on-call routing via Messages + configurable on-call contacts. Duplicate of the related OOH Make Safe request — will implement as one feature.
Deferred (duplicate): Same as Out-of-hours Make Safe communication. Merge into one item when scheduling the on-call routing feature.
Deferred (needs product scope with Brett/Matt Nas): Job/claim delay attribution (insurer/internal/insured) + simple export. Not started in this pass.
Deferred: Assessment required-field checklist + playbook→tasks generation. Larger feature; not started in this pass.
Deferred: Tentative/held appointment status to reserve estimation time before customer confirmation. Not started in this pass.
Deferred (duplicate): Auto bill vs PO variance highlight. Will implement once as a single feature using existing bill–PO links.
Deferred (duplicate of bill vs PO compare): Same feature request — merge when scheduling variance UI.
Deferred: Prefer catalogue/naming for makesafe PO lines; optional line category/tag if needed. Not started in this pass.
